A1.justification: Both complete, readable 25-page PDFs describe the same research work. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison cover the main text, equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendices A–B.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic-grid and molecular-generation experiments in Sections 5–6 and Appendix B, including distribution errors, sample-quality metrics, inference costs, and ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results in Sections 5–6 and Appendix B, including fragment-based and atom-based molecular-generation evaluations.

M1.justification: The reaching-probability-weighted mixing policy, Model F and DB F variants, and reward-sharpened scalarization procedure in Section 4 and Appendix B.2 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 32×32 synthetic grid and reward functions, fragment-based molecular generation, and atom-based QM9 generation, with identical objective combinations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including MOGFN, HN-GFN, OP-GFN, classifier guidance, and ensemble baselines in their respective main-text and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1 and 6.1 and Appendix B retain identical training budgets, model configurations, reward processing, preference vectors, sample counts, metrics, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Distortion-factor and temperature analyses, reaching-probability and training-objective ablations, molecular-validity analysis, and reward-correlation case studies are unchanged, including Table A3 and Table A9/Figure A8.

E5.justification: The existing three-seed reporting and means and standard deviations in molecular-result tables are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises statistical estimation or uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and qualitative findings match throughout Tables 1–7, Tables A2–A9, and the figures. No results are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Proposition 4.1, Appendix A's lemmas, proofs and derivations, and Appendix B.2's reward-sharpened composition equations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about composition without additional training, exact linear scalarization, nonlinear approximation, and competitive empirical performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of approximation accuracy, inference overhead, molecular validity, and contrast-operator limitations under positively correlated rewards remain identical, including the appendix discussion.

D1.justification: Implementation explanations, architecture details, hyperparameters, reward-processing instructions, and the code-availability statement are unchanged in the main text and Appendix B.

R1.justification: Section 2, research citations, and the bibliography retain the same works and the same positioning relative to prior GFlowNet and model-composition research.

P1.justification: Page 10 adds IITP grant RS-2019-II191906 for the Artificial Intelligence Graduate School Program (POSTECH) and adjusts acknowledgement wording. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded acknowledgement slightly reflows the left column and reference spacing on page 10. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding attribution and updates version/date metadata, with slight local layout reflow. The scientific content, empirical support, interpretations, and reproducibility information—including the appendices—are identical, leaving overall paper quality meaningfully unchanged.
